en: Black‑and‑white street view showing a row of historic multi‑story buildings on the left and a tree‑lined open space on the right. A few pedestrians and children are visible on the street. Shop signs can be seen on the façades, and printed caption text at the bottom reads "Marienberg i. Sa. Am Markt." The perspective looks along a gently rising street that forms part of the town's market area.
